title: install.sh Omnibus — 框架全部件部署 + 升级 update (commands/rules/experts/skills/hooks)
description:
EPIC-160 — install.sh 升级: framework 全部件 (commands/rules/experts/skills/hooks/settings) 在新环境 onboarding 跟 update 时一并部署+升级. 当前 install.sh 只覆盖 ~50% 部件 (commands/skills/settings), rules/ + experts/ + skills/{default,extended,scripts,skills}/ 等 ~40 files 0 处理.

**Context**: 主公 2026-08-03 拍板 — 'kallax 里的 command、rules、experts…等等都是框架的一部分, 在新环境 onboarding 以及 update 的时候都应该一并部署和升级'. 这是 4-branch governance 跟 EPIC-074 流程治理一致性需求, 不是新功能, 是治理债.

**当前 install.sh 覆盖率 (~50%)**:
- ✅ commands/*.md + *.sh (~30 files, 全 install)
- ✅ skills/kallax/ (顶层 install, 含 SKILL.md)
- ⚠️ settings.json (install but rules refer to UserPromptSubmit hook)
- ⚠️ hooks/ (2 files referenced by settings.json but not explicitly copied)
- ❌ .claude/rules/*.md (4 files, EPIC-159 新增, 0 install)
- ❌ experts/*.md + index/experts-index.yml (5 files, 0 install)
- ❌ skills/kallax/{default,extended,scripts,skills}/ sub-modules (~12 files, 0 install)
- ❌ skills/caveman/ (separate skill, ~5 files, 0 install)

**核心改动**:

1. **新 `--update` flag**: 区别首次 install (--target) vs 升级 update. 升级时不破坏 user-customized files, 走 symlink mode (per install.sh:235 已有 symlink 模式).

2. **新 `--inventory` flag**: 列 source→target 映射表, 给用户透明可见部署计划 (跟 EPIC-069-D check-claim-evidence 1:1 — 透明可验证).

3. **新 framework 部件部署**: rules/ + experts/ + skills/{kallax,default,extended,scripts,skills}/ + skills/caveman/ 全部 install. 总 ~40 files.

4. **5-Level Verify 5/5**: install --dry-run + install 真跑 + update 真跑 + inventory 列表完整 + 0 破坏 user files (re-run 后 byte-identical symlink targets).

**跟现有 Rule 联合 (0 冲突)**:
- EPIC-069-D check-claim-evidence: ✅ inventory 透明可验证
- EPIC-074 4-branch flow: ✅ install.sh 改动走 4-PR
- EPIC-131/132 dead-code gate-paint 防御: ✅ install.sh 改动不引入 dead code
- EPIC-159 .claude/rules/*.md: ✅ rules/ 现在自动 install (跟 .claude/skills/ 1:1)
- EPIC-150 canary: ✅ 用骨架 (.gitignore + scripts) 跟 install.sh 兼容

**scope**:
- 改: scripts/install.sh (~50 lines 新增 + 5 行 flag + 4 个 install function)
- 加: tests/integration/install-omnibus.test.sh (~150 lines, ≥6 case)
- 加: .claude/rules/installation.md (新 path-scoped rules)
- 不改: 任何 source code / 已 install 的部件路径 / immutable scripts / CLAUDE.md 主文件

**0 增 Rule, 0 增 immutable script, 0 改 source code**
acceptance: AC1: install.sh --inventory 列 source→target 映射表 (≥40 files, 含 rules/experts/skills 全部件)
AC2: install.sh 真跑后 ~/.claude/ 部署完整: commands/ + skills/{kallax,caveman} + rules/ + hooks/ + experts/ + settings.json 全部
AC3: install.sh --update 升级模式不破坏 user-customized files (走 symlink mode per install.sh:235)
AC4: tests/integration/install-omnibus.test.sh ≥6 case PASS (inventory / 真 install / --update symlink / rules deployed / experts deployed / re-run idempotent)
AC5: vitest sentinel + scan-dead-code 仍 PASS (无 regression)
AC7: CHANGELOG [3.32.5] entry with raw_output refs (per EPIC-069-D check-claim-evidence)
AC8: CLAUDE.md 加 EPIC-160 段 (跟 EPIC-159 段 1:1 模式)
AC11: 4-branch flow 走完 (feature → testing → main → miao)
AC12: 0 改 source code (kallax/node/src/*, kallax/rust/* 完全不动)
rule_references: install.sh:235 (symlink mode 已有 — --update 复用)
deliverables: scripts/install.sh (改 ~50 lines, 加 --update/--inventory flag + 4 install function)
